def get_positional_encoding(seq_len: int, d_model: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    assert d_model % 2 == 0, "d_model must be even"
    pos = np.arange(seq_len)[:, None]
    i = np.arange(d_model // 2)[None, :]
    denom = np.power(10000, 2 * i / d_model)

    pe = np.zeros((seq_len, d_model))
    pe[:, 0::2] = np.sin(pos / denom)
    pe[:, 1::2] = np.cos(pos / denom)

    df = pd.DataFrame(pe, columns=[f"dim_{k}" for k in range(d_model)])
    df.index.name = "pos"
    return df

df = get_positional_encoding(seq_len=1000, d_model=64)

select mcs.name_hy ,qqt.update_time,mcs.sw_l3 ,sum(qqt.vol) as vol,sum(qqt.amount) as amount,
sum(case when qqt.pct_chg > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as cnt1,sum(case when qqt.pct_chg < 0 then 1 else 1 end) as cnt2,
sum(case when qqt.pct_chg > 0 then 1 else 0 end)/(sum(case when qqt.pct_chg > 0 then 1 else 0 end) +sum(case when qqt.pct_chg < 0 then 1 else 1 end)) as pct
from qq_qt_detail_tmp AS qqt join my_choice_stock AS mcs on qqt.symbol = mcs.symbol
where qqt.update_time >= '2026-10-15 09:32:00'
group by mcs.name_hy,qqt.update_time ,mcs.sw_l3
having pct >= 0.15
order by pct desc;
